name: wv_search_businesses
description: Search the West Virginia Secretary of State business organization records by entity name. The register matches names that contain the text you give, so a short word returns many organisations; each row carries match = exact | legal_form_variant | name_prefix, ranked in that order, and hits counts only the exact and legal_form_variant rows. Tolerant of case, "&" vs "and" and the legal-form spelling (Inc / Incorporated, LLC / L.L.C.). Returns each organisation's file_number (the register's organization id), name, entity type, locale (domestic = formed in West Virginia, foreign = formed elsewhere and registered there), profit class, status, and effective, established and termination dates and reason. The register publishes no status column: status_normalized is active when no termination is recorded, inactive otherwise. status_basis says so on every row (always inferred). Fictitious-name, trademark and emblem registrations are included and marked in name_kind; they are not companies. total_in_register is the number of organisation rows the register returned. Entity-level only: no individuals' names and no addresses. Each call takes roughly 3 to 6 seconds, because the register's form must be loaded and submitted after a short pause.

active_only.description: Only organisations with no termination recorded. Default false.

name: wv_get_business
description: One West Virginia Secretary of State business organization by its organization id (file_number from wv_search_businesses): name, entity type, locale, profit class, status, dates and termination reason, plus business purpose (the register's industry code and text), charter county, charter state and control number. Entity-level only: no officers, members, organisers, agents or addresses are returned. found is false only when the register answered and holds no such id.
